title: Austin Fee Waivers Approved
summary:
*   **New Fee Exemption Program:** The Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was approved to manage the city's Capital Recovery Fee Exemption Program.
*   **Lowering Development Costs:** This program aims to reduce project expenses by allowing the waiver of specific fees, typically associated with city infrastructure development.
*   **Program Oversight & Guidelines:** AHFC will be responsible for overseeing the program's administration and approving its guidelines through September 1998.

BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
MINUTES
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 21, 1997
The Board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened. The
following agenda item (set forth on the City of Austin Council Meeting agenda as item 52)
was considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors. 1.
Approve a resolution authorizing negotiation and execution of a contract with the City of
Austin for the administration of the City's Capital Recovery Fee Exemption Program by the
Austin Housing Finance Corporation through September 30, 1998, and approve the Program
Guidelines.
(Administration expenses are included in the 1996-97 Austin Housing Finance Corporation
Budget.) (Related to item 46)
AHFC Resolution No. 97-0821-01 was approved on President Garcia's motion, Board Member
Slusher's second by a 4-0 vote. Board Member Spelman abstained..
The meeting was adjourned.
